name: @arena/epoch-adapter
description: Provider-neutral Epoch capability-development adapter (A026): typed translation of EPI1.0 incoming requests into Arena capability-case provisioning and typed Arena-output refs, with the asynchronous job envelope (job id, correlation id, causation id, idempotency key, artifact digests, authorization metadata, explicit lifecycle) and a structurally enforced Epoch authority boundary (no World-Model mutation surface).
